description: The MCP Teleporter: the Exit gate of The Commons. Lists the other MCP servers you can teleport to from here — endpoint, transport, auth, and per-destination teleport instructions. Exits are information only: teleporting means pointing YOUR OWN MCP client at the destination; the hub never connects for you, never proxies credentials, and never sends your hub key anywhere. Anonymous — no hub key needed. Public and educational listings are free forever.
name: hub_list_exits
